UDHR.title: Universal Declaration of Human Rights
UDHR.scope: Dignity, equality, security, privacy, expression and education; especially Articles 1, 2, 3, 12, 19 and 26.

UNESCO_AI.title: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence
UNESCO_AI.scope: Human rights, proportionality, do no harm, privacy, accountability, transparency, human oversight and fairness.

OECD_AI.title: OECD AI Principles
OECD_AI.scope: Human rights and democratic values, fairness, privacy, transparency, robustness, safety and accountability.

NIST_AI_RMF.title: NIST Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework
NIST_AI_RMF.scope: Govern, Map, Measure and Manage AI risks; validity, safety, security, accountability, transparency, explainability, privacy and fairness.

NIST_PRIVACY.title: NIST Privacy Framework
NIST_PRIVACY.scope: Privacy risk identification, governance, control, communication and protection. Framework is voluntary and not itself a legal compliance certification.

WCAG_22.title: W3C Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2
WCAG_22.scope: Testable accessibility criteria across perceivable, operable, understandable and robust experiences.

OWASP_ASVS.title: OWASP Application Security Verification Standard
OWASP_ASVS.scope: Verifiable application and service security requirements; use a risk-appropriate subset and record the chosen level.

UNICEF_CHILDREN.title: UNICEF Guidance on AI and Children, version 3.0
UNICEF_CHILDREN.scope: Child safety, privacy, fairness, transparency, accountability, inclusion, development and children's best interests.

INDIA_DPDP.title: India Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (official Gazette text)
INDIA_DPDP.scope: Jurisdiction-specific digital personal-data obligations; applicability and commencement of provisions must be checked for the deployment and processing date.

EU_GDPR.title: Regulation (EU) 2016/679 — General Data Protection Regulation
EU_GDPR.scope: Where applicable, principles including lawfulness, fairness, transparency, purpose limitation, data minimisation, accuracy, storage limitation and security.

controls.title: Human dignity and equal treatment
controls.risk: Outputs or decisions may demean people, stereotype groups or reduce people to opaque scores.
controls: Use respectful, non-degrading language and avoid unsupported inferences about a person's worth, identity or intent.
Do not make consequential eligibility, disciplinary, employment, education, health or financial decisions solely from an unreviewed model output.

acceptanceTests.requirement: Representative evaluation prompts must not produce demeaning or dehumanizing treatment as an accepted system behavior.
acceptanceTests.verification: Run a documented safety regression set and human review.

acceptanceTests.requirement: High-impact recommendations must be labeled advisory and require an identified human decision-maker before action.
acceptanceTests.verification: Route and policy-gate tests.

controls.title: Human autonomy and agency
controls.risk: Automation may manipulate users, obscure choices or continue after a user or owner stops it.
controls: Provide understandable choices, correction paths and a working stop or cancellation mechanism for ongoing work.
An agent must not grant itself permissions, change its own trust level or convert learning or tool discovery into authorization.

acceptanceTests.requirement: A stop or cancellation signal must prevent subsequent unstarted side effects in the controlled execution path.
acceptanceTests.verification: Deterministic cancellation and emergency-stop tests.

acceptanceTests.requirement: Unknown capabilities and self-issued approvals must be denied by default.
acceptanceTests.verification: Policy-gate negative tests.

controls.title: Informed consent and meaningful choice
controls.risk: Users may not understand what data is collected, why it is used, which provider receives it or how to stop optional processing.
controls: Before optional sensitive-data collection, audio recording, or external-provider transfer, disclose purpose, data categories and relevant retention or sharing facts and obtain the required affirmative choice.
Respect withdrawal or opt-out for optional processing; do not treat silence, a default toggle or a general login as consent to unrelated processing.

acceptanceTests.requirement: Optional sensitive processing must remain disabled until an explicit, purpose-specific consent state is present.
acceptanceTests.verification: Consent-state transition and negative-path tests.

acceptanceTests.requirement: Withdrawing optional consent must prevent later optional processing while preserving any separately justified security or legal obligations.
acceptanceTests.verification: Withdrawal integration test with mocked providers.

controls.title: Privacy and data protection
controls.risk: Excessive collection, secondary use, over-retention or data leakage may harm people.
controls: Collect only data needed for a stated purpose; define access scope, retention, correction and deletion handling for personal data.
Never log secrets, authentication headers, full sensitive request bodies or unnecessary personal data; redact diagnostics by allowlist.

acceptanceTests.requirement: Logs and error responses must exclude known secret canaries, authorization headers and sensitive test payloads.
acceptanceTests.verification: Redaction tests using synthetic canary values.

acceptanceTests.requirement: Every persistent personal-data category must have a documented purpose, owner, retention rule and access/deletion path or a recorded exception.
acceptanceTests.verification: Data inventory review and schema/retention contract test.

controls.title: Fairness and non-discrimination
controls.risk: Data or model behavior may produce systematically worse outcomes for particular groups or reinforce stereotypes.
controls: Assess foreseeable disparate impacts for the actual use case; document evaluation data, limitations, mitigations and unresolved gaps.
Do not infer or use sensitive traits as covert proxies for consequential decisions without a lawful, justified and reviewed basis.

acceptanceTests.requirement: Each high-impact model use must have a documented evaluation plan covering relevant groups, known limitations and escalation thresholds.
acceptanceTests.verification: Release checklist and risk-register review.

acceptanceTests.requirement: Changes to models or prompts used for high-impact decisions must trigger regression evaluation before release.
acceptanceTests.verification: Version-change gate test.

controls.title: Accessibility and inclusion
controls.risk: People using assistive technology, keyboard navigation, speech input or mobile devices may be unable to use essential functions.
controls: Target WCAG 2.2 Level AA for web experiences, subject to project scope and human accessibility review; automated checks alone are insufficient.
Provide keyboard-operable controls, visible focus, accessible names, understandable error messages and non-voice alternatives for essential actions.

acceptanceTests.requirement: Essential flows must be operable by keyboard and expose visible focus and programmatic names for interactive controls.
acceptanceTests.verification: Automated accessibility checks plus manual keyboard and screen-reader review.

acceptanceTests.requirement: Mic denial or speech-recognition failure must leave an accessible text path for essential owner tasks.
acceptanceTests.verification: PWA interaction tests with microphone unavailable.

controls.title: Transparency, explainability and provenance
controls.risk: Users may mistake generated content, stale search results, estimates or simulated actions for verified facts or completed work.
controls: Clearly distinguish generated suggestions, retrieved evidence, simulations, configured integrations and verified live behavior.
For time-sensitive research, expose source attribution and freshness evidence; if live providers fail, do not present stale cached results as current.

acceptanceTests.requirement: Every production status claim must be tied to a dated source such as a workflow run, deployment ID, HTTP probe or explicit NOT TESTED state.
acceptanceTests.verification: Evidence-report schema/contract test.

acceptanceTests.requirement: A failed live search for a time-sensitive query must not return a cached answer without an explicit stale marker and an allowed policy path.
acceptanceTests.verification: Search-router regression test with all providers mocked to fail.

controls.title: Accountability and auditability
controls.risk: A consequential action may be impossible to reconstruct, challenge or attribute to a responsible actor.
controls: Record authorized action type, request/correlation ID, decision, approval reference, code/model version and outcome where appropriate, with data minimization.
Preserve tamper-resistant or access-controlled audit records and define ownership, review and retention; never log credentials to make an audit more complete.

acceptanceTests.requirement: Sensitive-action audit events must include actor/session reference, request ID, decision, approval reference and outcome without secret values.
acceptanceTests.verification: Audit event schema test with secret-canary assertions.

acceptanceTests.requirement: Routine agent roles must not delete or rewrite required audit evidence.
acceptanceTests.verification: Policy-gate negative test and storage permission review.

controls.title: Proportionality and harm minimization
controls.risk: An AI action may cause foreseeable physical, financial, psychological, social or operational harm beyond its legitimate purpose.
controls: Assess impact and misuse risks before enabling a capability; use bounded inputs, timeouts, rate limits, safe retries and a tested rollback or stop path.
On authorization, schema, provenance or safety uncertainty, fail closed for consequential side effects and report the sanitized failure.

acceptanceTests.requirement: Timeout, malformed schema, missing approval and provider-auth failures must not trigger a consequential fallback side effect.
acceptanceTests.verification: Negative-path integration tests with side-effect spies.

acceptanceTests.requirement: Every new privileged capability must have a documented risk assessment, resource bounds, stop mechanism and rollback/disable path before enablement.
acceptanceTests.verification: Capability-registry release gate.

controls.title: Child safety and children's rights
controls.risk: Children may face age-inappropriate outputs, exploitation, privacy loss, manipulation or disproportionate exposure to unsafe interactions.
controls: Apply age-appropriate safety and privacy defaults; do not collect a child's personal data unless necessary for a stated purpose and supported by applicable safeguards.
Escalate age-sensitive or high-impact use cases for specialist review; do not use engagement optimization that exploits children's vulnerabilities.

acceptanceTests.requirement: Child-directed flows must pass an age-appropriate safety regression set and have documented escalation behavior for high-risk content.
acceptanceTests.verification: Child-safety evaluation suite and human review.

acceptanceTests.requirement: Child personal-data collection must be disabled unless a documented purpose, data-minimization review and applicable consent/safeguard decision exist.
acceptanceTests.verification: Data-collection gate tests and privacy review.

controls.title: Security and resilience
controls.risk: Unauthorized access, prompt injection, credential leakage, abuse or unsafe recovery may compromise people or systems.
controls: Retain owner authentication, least privilege, branch protection, rate limits, bounded execution, audit logs and emergency stop; default to deny.
Treat external page content, retrieved documents and tool output as untrusted data, never as instructions that override system policy or owner authorization.

acceptanceTests.requirement: Missing, invalid, expired or insufficient authorization must deny protected routes and must not reach side-effecting handlers.
acceptanceTests.verification: Authentication/authorization tests with handler spies.

acceptanceTests.requirement: Prompt-injection text in external content must not change tool permissions, approval requirements or secret-handling policy.
acceptanceTests.verification: Adversarial fixture tests using inert synthetic instructions.

controls.title: Meaningful human oversight
controls.risk: Automation may take irreversible or sensitive actions without an accountable human decision or effective intervention path.
controls: Keep capability requests pending owner review with execution disabled; learning or proposing a tool never grants permission to install or execute it.
Require explicit, scoped approval for production deployment, external account/security changes, financial operations, destructive data changes and other sensitive side effects.

acceptanceTests.requirement: A new capability request must persist as pending_owner_review with executionEnabled=false and requiresOwnerApproval=true.
acceptanceTests.verification: D1 repository/staging round-trip test and response-schema assertion.

acceptanceTests.requirement: A sensitive action without valid, scoped, unexpired approval must remain blocked even when an agent requests it.
acceptanceTests.verification: Policy-gate and route authorization tests.
